title: ANZ, NAB among banks funding Blackstone HSBC book buy, AFR says
article:
(Aug 2): ANZ Group Holdings Ltd and National Australia Bank Ltd are among lenders bankrolling Blackstone Inc’s A$36 billion (US$25.3 billion) purchase of HSBC Holdings Plc’s Australian retail loan portfolio, the Australian Financial Review reported Sunday, citing unnamed sources.

Blackstone has arranged at least A$30 billion in senior debt through a privately offered residential mortgage-backed securitisation, the AFR said. ANZ and NAB were part of a debt stack that includes foreign banks, the newspaper reported.

NAB declined to comment and ANZ didn’t immediately respond to a Bloomberg email sent outside office hours.

Blackstone and the lenders are to put a public securitisation deal to credit funds and other institutional investors within 12 months of ownership, the AFR reported.

Pepper Money Ltd, a domestic shadow lender backed by KKR & Co, will service the loan portfolio for Australian customers. The deal, announced Friday, is expected to close in the first half of next year.
